headline: Toured completed addition and renovations at Hamden Hall School, 20 Davis Street, with no votes taken.
summary: Members observed the new addition and renovations, completed under the April 2024 approval of a major amendment to Site Plan #19-1322. There was not a quorum at the tour, so no decisions were made.
plain_text:
Site Tour: Completed Project at 20 Davis Street (Hamden Hall School) 
Attendees: 
Chairman Mastropetre 
Vice Chairman McDonagh 
Commissioner Bond 
Commissioner Pearce 
 
5:30 PM  
There was not a quorum present at the tour. 
Members observed new addition/renovations completed in accordance with the April 2024 
approval of Major Amendment to Site Plan #19-1322.
